from jinja2 import Template

template_str = """Dear [Name], thank you for your offer to help out with my gardening. I really appreciate the time you can spare, and I know you have a good reputation for caring for plants and flowers with a gentle touch. I have attached a photo of the roses in my front garden, and I would love your help with them this weekend. I hope to hear from you soon. regards, [Your Name]"""

template = Template(template_str, autoescape=True)

name = request.args.get('name', '')
email = request.args.get('email', '')
template.render(name=name, email=email)
